gbpDescription: Uriah Child Care is a licensed child care center at 30 W Chestnut Ave in Vineland, NJ, led by Ms. Paulette, who has cared for Cumberland County children since 2005. We serve families in Vineland, Millville and Bridgeton with toddler care, kindergarten readiness, and before and after school care for ages 2.5 and up. We are open Monday to Saturday, early morning to 11 pm, for parents who work early mornings, evenings and Saturdays. Our play-based curriculum builds language, social and early learning skills, and parents get regular updates about their child's day. We accept NJ childcare subsidy (CCAP) for families who qualify and take part in the USDA food program (CACFP). Book a tour to see our classrooms and meet Ms. Paulette.
